component.name: uQbit
component.summary: Torrent client that follows the uQ theme

description.p: uQbit downloads and shares torrents with qBittorrent's engine (qbittorrent-nox) running in the background, in a window that follows uQ's theme live. It opens magnet links and .torrent files, keeps seeding after the window closes if you want it to, and tells you when a download finishes.
Search plugins in qBittorrent's plugin folder, such as the ones qbit-plugin-dl installs, show up in uQbit by themselves.
Crashes and engine problems show up in uQ's Settings, with a report to copy.
